bio.text: Kyle Kirkland is the Republican candidate for California's 21st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was born in Virginia, lives in California, and earned an A.B. from Harvard College in 1984 and an M.B.A. from Stanford University's Graduate School of Business in 1988.

He founded an investment banking firm in 1994, was chairman of Steinway Musical Instruments from 1993 to 2011, and served as president of the California Gaming Association; as of 2024 he was board chair of the Fresno Chaffee Zoo.
